7. claims 8 and 20 are rejected under 35 u.s.c. 112, second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which applicant regards as the invention. this is because they use vague terms making the claims vague and indefinite.
7.1 claim 8, lines 1-2 state, “validating that the input data files describe a pipeline system that may be optimized”. the use of the term “may be” makes the claim vague and indefinite as to if the pipeline system that is optimized or not.
7.2 claim 20, lines 1-2 state, “validating that the input data files describe a pipeline system that may be optimized”. the use of the term “may be” makes the claim vague and indefinite as to if the pipeline system that is optimized or not.
